topic: Day 51 — reel — Growth feels like confusion before it feels like progress
text:
Confusion is
what [rebuilding]
feels like
from inside.
caption:
The disoriented stretch before things click gets read as going backward. It's the old model loosening so a better one can form.

Follow for one of these a day.
